units.zh: 出帝父敬儒，高祖兄也，為唐莊宗騎將，早卒，高祖以其子重貴為子。
units.en: The Fleeing Emperor’s father, Jingru, was Gaozu’s elder brother—a horseman under Tang’s Zhuangzong who died young. Gaozu adopted his son Chonggui.
units.literal: The Fleeing Emperor’s father Jingru was Gaozu’s elder brother, a cavalry general of Tang’s Zhuangzong; he died early, and Gaozu took his son Chonggui as his own son.

units.zh: 高祖六子，五皆早死，而重睿幼，故重貴得立。
units.en: Of Gaozu’s six sons five had died in childhood and Chongrui was still an infant, so the throne passed to Chonggui.
units.literal: Gaozu had six sons; five all died early, while Chongrui was still young, so Chonggui obtained the succession.

units.zh: 重貴少而謹厚，善騎射。
units.en: As a youth Chonggui was steady and modest, and a capable horse-archer.
units.literal: Chonggui in youth was prudent and sincere, and skilled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 高祖使博士王震教以《禮記》，久之，不能通大義，謂震曰：「此非我家事也。」
units.en: Gaozu set the Erudite Wang Zhen to instruct him in the Book of Rites. Months passed without his mastering the text’s larger sense, and he told Zhen, “Ritual learning is not our house’s trade.”
units.literal: Gaozu had the Erudite Wang Zhen teach him the Book of Rites; after long study he could not grasp its great meaning, and said to Zhen, “This is not my family’s affair.”

units.zh: 高祖為契丹所立，謀以一子留守太原。
units.en: When Gaozu, enthroned with Khitan backing, planned to station a son at Taiyuan,
units.literal: Gaozu, installed by the Khitan, plotted to leave one son to guard Taiyuan.

units.zh: 契丹使盡出諸子自擇之，指重貴曰：「此眼大者可也。」
units.en: the Khitan envoy had every son presented for his choice. He pointed at Chonggui and said, “The wide-eyed boy will serve.”
units.literal: the Khitan envoy had all the sons come forth for him to choose; he pointed at Chonggui and said, “This one with the big eyes will do.”

units.zh: 遂拜金紫光祿大夫，行太原尹、北京留守，知河東節度事。
units.en: Chonggui was then made Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, acting prefect of Taiyuan, regent of the Northern Capital, and commissioner of the Hedong command.
units.literal: Thereupon he was invested Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, acting Taiyuan metropolitan magistrate, Northern Capital regent, and overseer of the Hedong military commission.

units.zh: 天福二年九月，召拜左金吾衛上將軍。
units.en: In the ninth month of the second Tianfu year he was recalled and named senior general of the Left Golden Guards.
units.literal: In the ninth month of Tianfu year 2 he was summoned and appointed senior general of the Left Golden Guards.

units.zh: 三年冬，為開封尹，封鄭王，加太尉，同中書門下平章事。
units.en: That winter he took the Kaifeng metropolitan magistracy, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and was raised to Grand Commandant and Associate Grand Councilor.
units.literal: In winter of year 3 he became Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate, was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng, was given the Grand Commandant, and made Associate Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 六年，高祖幸鄴，留守東京。
units.en: In the sixth year, while Gaozu went to Ye, he stayed behind as guardian of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: In year 6, when Gaozu visited Ye, he remained to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 已而為廣晉尹，徙封齊王。
units.en: He was soon made Guangjin metropolitan magistrate and re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
units.literal: Soon after he became Guangjin metropolitan magistrate and was transferred to Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 七年六月乙丑，高祖崩，皇帝即位於柩前。
units.en: On yichou of the sixth month in the seventh year Gaozu died, and the emperor took the throne before the coffin.
units.literal: In the sixth month of year 7, on yichou, Gaozu died; the emperor succeeded at the bier.

units.zh: 庚午，使右驍衞將軍石德超以御馬二，撲祭于相州之西山。
units.en: On gengwu, Shi Dechao of the Right Brave Guard took two imperial horses to perform the pu sacrifice at Xiangzhou’s Western Hill.
units.literal: On gengwu, Shi Dechao, General of the Right Brave Guard, was sent with two imperial horses to perform the pu sacrifice at the Western Hill of Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 夷狄之禮也。
units.en: This was a barbarian rite.
units.literal: It was a rite of the Yi and Di barbarians.

units.zh: 如京使李仁廓使於契丹，契丹使梅李來。
units.en: Li Renkuo, envoy to the capital, went on embassy to the Khitan; the Khitan envoy Mei Li arrived.
units.literal: Capital envoy Li Renkuo was sent on embassy to the Khitan; the Khitan envoy Mei Li came.

units.zh: 丙子，馮道為大行皇帝山陵使，門下侍郎竇貞固為副，太常卿崔梲為禮儀使，戶部侍郎呂琦為鹵簿使，御史中丞王易簡為儀仗使。
units.en: On bingzi, Feng Dao was appointed commissioner for the late emperor’s mausoleum, with Menxia vice director Dou Zhengu as deputy; Cui Yuan oversaw the rites, Lü Qi the procession, and censor-in-chief Wang Yijian the honor guard.
units.literal: On bingzi, Feng Dao was made commissioner for the late emperor’s mausoleum; Menxia Vice Director Dou Zhengu was deputy; Chamberlain for Ceremonials Cui Yuan was rites commissioner; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was procession commissioner; and Censor-in-chief Wang Yijian was honor-guard commissioner.

units.zh: 舊史、實錄無橋道頓遞使，疑不置，或闕書。
units.en: The old history and the Veritable Records list no commissioner for bridges, roads, and relays; perhaps the office was not appointed, or perhaps it was omitted.
units.literal: The old history and Veritable Records have no bridge-road and relay commissioner; perhaps none was appointed, or perhaps it was omitted.

units.zh: 漢高祖亦然。
units.en: It was the same for Gaozu of Han.
units.literal: It was the same for Gaozu of Han.

units.zh: 己卯，四方館使朱崇節、右金吾衞大將軍梁言使于契丹。
units.en: On jimao, Zhu Chongjie of the Four Directions Hostel and Liang Yan, Grand General of the Right Gold Guard, went as envoys to the Khitan.
units.literal: On jimao, Zhu Chongjie, commissioner of the Four Directions Hostel, and Liang Yan, Grand General of the Right Gold Guard, were sent as envoys to the Khitan.

units.zh: 秋七月壬辰，皇祖母劉氏崩，輟視朝三日。
units.en: On renchen of the seventh month the emperor’s grandmother, Lady Liu, died and the court mourned in recess for three days.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, the emperor’s grandmother Lady Liu died; court audiences were suspended for three days.

units.zh: 丁酉，使石德超撲馬於相州之西山。
units.en: On dingyou Shi Dechao was again sent to perform the dash-horse rite at Xiang’s Western Hills.
units.literal: On dingyou Shi Dechao was again sent to dash horses at the Western Hills of Xiang prefecture.

units.zh: 庚子，大赦。
units.en: On gengzi the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: On gengzi a great amnesty.

units.zh: 甲辰，契丹使通事來。
units.en: On jiachen a Khitan interpreter envoy arrived.
units.literal: On jiachen the Khitan interpreter envoy came.

units.zh: 八月戊午，高行周克襄州。
units.en: On wuwu of the eighth month Gao Xingzhou took Xiang prefecture.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuwu, Gao Xingzhou captured Xiang prefecture.

units.zh: 安從進自焚死，故不書伏誅。
units.en: Because An Congjin burned himself to death, the text does not say he was executed.
units.literal: An Congjin burned himself to death; therefore it does not write that he was executed.

units.zh: 庚申，天平軍節度使景延廣、義成軍節度使李守貞、彰德軍節度使郭謹，進錢粟助作山陵。
units.en: On gengshen Jing Yanguang of Tianping, Li Shouzhen of Yicheng, and Guo Jin of Zhangde sent money and grain to help build the imperial tomb.
units.literal: On gengshen Jing Yanguang of the Tianping army, Li Shouzhen of the Yicheng army, and Guo Jin of the Zhangde army presented money and grain to aid the tomb works.

units.zh: 甲子，契丹使郎五來。
units.en: On jiazi the Khitan envoy Lang Wu arrived.
units.literal: On jiazi the Khitan envoy Lang Wu came.

units.zh: 庚午，葬皇祖母於魏縣。
units.en: On gengwu the emperor’s grandmother was interred in Wei county.
units.literal: On gengwu the emperor’s grandmother was buried at Wei county.

units.zh: 癸酉，契丹使其客省使張九思來。
units.en: On guiyou the Khitan dispatched Zhang Jiusi of the Guest Affairs Office.
units.literal: On guiyou the Khitan sent their Guest Affairs commissioner Zhang Jiusi.

units.zh: 九月辛丑，李守貞為大行皇帝山陵都部署。
units.en: On xinchou Li Shouzhen was named overall director of the tomb works.
units.literal: On xinchou Li Shouzhen was made overall director of the late emperor’s tomb deployment.

units.zh: 冬十月己未，契丹使舍利來。
units.en: On jiwei of the tenth month the Khitan envoy Sheli arrived.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, the Khitan envoy Sheli came.

units.zh: 庚午，回鶻遣使者來。
units.en: On gengwu Uyghur envoys came to court.
units.literal: On gengwu the Uyghurs sent envoys.

units.zh: 十一月，契丹使大卿來。
units.en: In the eleventh month the Khitan envoy Daqing arrived.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Khitan envoy Daqing came.

units.zh: 庚寅，葬聖文章武孝皇帝於顯陵。
units.en: On gengyin Gaozu, temple name the Sagely, Literary, Martial, and Filial Emperor, was laid to rest at Xianling.
units.literal: On gengyin the Sagely, Literary, Martial, and Filial Emperor was buried at Xianling.

units.zh: 陵在河南壽安縣。
units.en: The mausoleum was in Shou’an county, Henan.
units.literal: The mausoleum was in Shou’an county, Henan.

units.zh: 五代之亂，至此七君，而不得其死者五，明宗雖善終，而愍帝不克葬，至廢帝時始克葬，故皆不書。
units.en: In the turmoil of the Five Dynasties, seven rulers had appeared by this point, and five did not die properly. Mingzong died peacefully, but Mindi could not be buried until Feidi’s reign, so those burials were not recorded.
units.literal: In the disorder of the Five Dynasties, down to this point there had been seven rulers, and five did not meet proper deaths; although Mingzong died well, Mindi could not be buried and only in Feidi’s time could he be buried, so none of these were written.

units.zh: 至此始見子得葬其父，故并祔廟詳書之。
units.en: Only here do we first see a son able to bury his father; therefore the text records both the burial and the temple enshrinement in detail.
units.literal: Only here does one first see a son able to bury his father; therefore it also writes in detail about enshrining him in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 己亥，牛羊使董殷使於契丹。
units.en: On jihai Dong Yin, commissioner of cattle and sheep, went on embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: On jihai Cattle-and-Sheep commissioner Dong Yin was sent on embassy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 庚子，祔高祖神主於太廟。
units.en: On gengzi Gaozu’s spirit tablet was placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On gengzi Gaozu’s spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 辛丑，蠲高祖靈車所過民租之半。
units.en: On xinchou communities along the funeral route had half their rent forgiven.
units.literal: On xinchou half the people’s rent along the route of Gaozu’s catafalque was remitted.

units.zh: 十二月庚午，北京留守劉知遠進百頭穹廬。
units.en: On gengwu of the twelfth month Liu Zhiyuan, regent of the Northern Capital, sent a hundred felt domed tents.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Northern Capital regent Liu Zhiyuan presented a hundred domed tents.

units.zh: 契丹於越使令骨支來。
units.en: Lingguzhi, envoy of the Khitan Yüehü, arrived.
units.literal: The Khitan Yüehü envoy Lingguzhi came.

units.zh: 辛未，又使野裏巳來。
units.en: On xinwei another Khitan envoy, Yelisi, came.
units.literal: On xinwei the Khitan again sent Yelisi.

units.zh: 丙子，于闐使都督劉再升來，沙州曹元深、瓜州曹元忠皆遣使附再升以來。
units.en: On bingzi Liu Zaisheng, commissioner of Khotan, arrived; Cao Yuanshen of Shazhou and Cao Yuanzhong of Guazhou sent envoys in his train.
units.literal: On bingzi Khotan’s commissioner Liu Zaisheng came; Cao Yuanshen of Shazhou and Cao Yuanzhong of Guazhou both sent envoys accompanying Zaisheng.

units.zh: 旱，蝗。
units.en: The land suffered drought and locust plagues.
units.literal: Drought; locusts.

units.zh: 八年春正月，契丹於越使烏多奧來。
units.en: In the first month of the eighth year the Khitan Yüehü envoy Wuduoao arrived.
units.literal: In spring of the eighth year, in the first month, the Khitan Yüehü envoy Wuduoao came.

units.zh: 二月壬子，景延廣為御營使。
units.en: On renzi of the second month Jing Yanguang was appointed commissioner of the imperial camp.
units.literal: In the second month, on renzi, Jing Yanguang was made commissioner of the imperial camp.

units.zh: 己未，如東京，赦廣晉府囚。
units.en: On jiwei he traveled to the Eastern Capital and freed Guangjin’s prisoners.
units.literal: On jiwei the emperor went to the Eastern Capital and pardoned the prisoners of Guangjin prefecture.

units.zh: 庚申，次澶州，赦囚。
units.en: On gengshen he stopped at Chanzou and proclaimed a prison amnesty.
units.literal: On gengshen he halted at Chanzou and pardoned prisoners.

units.zh: 乙丑，至自鄴都。
units.en: On yichou he returned from Ye.
units.literal: On yichou he returned from the capital of Ye.

units.zh: 庚午，寒食，望祭顯陵于南莊，焚御衣、紙錢。
units.en: On gengwu, Cold Food Day, a distant sacrifice was offered to Xianling at Nanzhuang, with imperial garments and paper money burned.
units.literal: On gengwu, the Cold Food Festival, a distant sacrifice was made to Xianling at Nanzhuang, and imperial garments and paper money were burned.

units.zh: 焚衣野祭之類，皆閭巷人之事，用之天子，見禮樂壞甚。
units.en: Burning clothes and such rustic sacrifices belonged to commoners; applying them to the Son of Heaven shows how badly ritual order had collapsed.
units.literal: Burning clothes and wild sacrifices of this sort are all affairs of common alley people; using them for the Son of Heaven shows that rites and music were greatly ruined.

units.zh: 三月己卯朔，趙瑩罷。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the third month Zhao Ying was dismissed.
units.literal: On the first day of the third month, jimao, Zhao Ying left office.

units.zh: 晉昌軍節度使桑維翰為侍中。
units.en: Sang Weihan, commissioner of the Jinchang army, was appointed Palace Secretary.
units.literal: Jinchang army commissioner Sang Weihan was made Palace Secretary.

units.zh: 辛丑，引進使、太府卿孟承誨使於契丹。
units.en: On xinchou Meng Chenghui, introducing commissioner and grand steward, went on embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: On xinchou Introducing commissioner and Grand Steward Meng Chenghui was sent on embassy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 蝗。
units.en: Locusts ravaged the fields.
units.literal: Locusts.

units.zh: 夏四月庚午，董殷使於契丹。
units.en: On gengwu of the fourth month Dong Yin again went on embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengwu, Dong Yin was sent on embassy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 供奉官張福率威順軍捕蝗於陳州。
units.en: Palace Attendant officer Zhang Fu led the Weishun army in locust drives through Chen prefecture.
units.literal: Palace Attendant officer Zhang Fu led the Weishun army to catch locusts in Chen prefecture.

units.zh: 五月，泰寧軍節度使安審信捕蝗於中都。
units.en: In the fifth month An Shenxin of the Tai’ning army hunted locusts around Zhongdu.
units.literal: In the fifth month Tai’ning army commissioner An Shenxin caught locusts in Zhongdu.

units.zh: 丁亥，追封皇伯敬儒為宋王。
units.en: On dinghai the emperor’s uncle Jingru was posthumously made Prince of Song.
units.literal: On dinghai the emperor’s uncle Jingru was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Song.

units.zh: 癸卯，馮道罷。
units.en: On guimao Feng Dao was dismissed.
units.literal: On guimao Feng Dao left office.

units.zh: 甲辰，以旱、蝗大赦。
units.en: On jiachen drought and locusts moved the throne to proclaim a general amnesty.
units.literal: On jiachen, because of drought and locusts, a great amnesty.

units.zh: 六月庚戌，祭蝗於臯門。
units.en: On gengxu the court offered sacrifice against the locusts at Gaomen.
units.literal: On gengxu locusts were sacrificed to at Gaomen.

units.zh: 癸亥，供奉官七人帥奉國軍捕蝗於京畿。
units.en: On guihai seven palace attendants led the Fengguo army in locust drives around the capital.
units.literal: On guihai seven Palace Attendant officers led the Fengguo army to catch locusts in the capital districts.

units.zh: 辛未，括借民粟，殺藏粟者。
units.en: On xinwei the court commandeered private grain stores and put hoarders to death.
units.literal: On xinwei the people’s grain was requisitioned on loan, and those who hoarded grain were executed.

units.zh: 秋七月甲午，冊皇太后。
units.en: On jiawu of the seventh month the empress dowager received her formal investiture.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiawu, the empress dowager was invested.

units.zh: 丁酉，射於南莊。
units.en: On dingyou he practiced archery at Nanzhuang.
units.literal: On dingyou the emperor shot at Nanzhuang.

units.zh: 契丹使梅里等來。
units.en: Khitan envoys led by Meili arrived.
units.literal: Khitan envoys including Meili came.

units.zh: 甲辰，供奉官李漢超帥奉國軍捕蝗於京畿。
units.en: On jiachen Li Hanchao of the Palace Attendants led the Fengguo army in locust drives around the capital.
units.literal: On jiachen Palace Attendant officer Li Hanchao led the Fengguo army to catch locusts in the capital districts.

units.zh: 八月丁未朔，募民捕蝗，易以粟。
units.en: On the dingwei new moon of the eighth month commoners were hired to gather locusts, paid in grain.
units.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, dingwei, the people were recruited to catch locusts, paid in grain.

units.zh: 辛亥，檢民青苗。
units.en: On xinhai officials inspected the people’s green grain in the fields.
units.literal: On xinhai the people’s standing crops were inspected.

units.zh: 九月戊寅，尊秦國夫人安氏為皇太妃。
units.en: On wuyin Lady An of Qin was elevated to imperial consort dowager.
units.literal: On wuyin Lady An of Qin was honored as imperial consort dowager.

units.zh: 丙申，幸大年莊及景延廣第。
units.en: On bingshen he visited Danian Estate and Jing Yanguang’s mansion.
units.literal: On bingshen the emperor visited Danianzhuang and Jing Yanguang’s residence.

units.zh: 冬十月戊申，立馮氏為皇后。
units.en: On wushen of the tenth month Lady Feng was crowned empress.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, Lady Feng was installed as empress.

units.zh: 馮氏於帝為叔母。
units.en: Lady Feng was the emperor’s aunt.
units.literal: Lady Feng was the emperor’s aunt.

units.zh: 壬子，畋於近郊，幸沙臺。
units.en: On renzi he hunted outside the walls and then went to Shatai.
units.literal: On renzi he hunted near the suburbs and visited Shatai.

units.zh: 丙寅，契丹使通事劉胤來。
units.en: On bingyin the Khitan interpreter Liu Yin arrived.
units.literal: On bingyin the Khitan interpreter Liu Yin came.

units.zh: 庚午，括借民粟。
units.en: On gengwu the court again commandeered private grain stores.
units.literal: On gengwu the people’s grain was again requisitioned on loan.

units.zh: 十一月己卯，董殷使於契丹。
units.en: On jimao of the eleventh month Dong Yin went on embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jimao, Dong Yin was sent on embassy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 甲申，幸八角，閱馬牧。
units.en: On jiashen he went to Bajiao and inspected the imperial stud.
units.literal: On jiashen the emperor visited Bajiao and reviewed the horse pastures.

units.zh: 乙未，契丹使梅里來。
units.en: On yiwei the Khitan envoy Meili arrived.
units.literal: On yiwei the Khitan envoy Meili came.

units.zh: 戊戌，齊州刺史楊承祚奔於青州。
units.en: On wuxu Yang Chengzuo, commissioner of Qi, defected to Qing prefecture.
units.literal: On wuxu Qi prefecture commissioner Yang Chengzuo fled to Qing prefecture.

units.zh: 辛丑，高麗使其廣評侍郎金仁逢來。
units.en: On xinchou Goryeo sent Jin Renfeng, vice director of the Broad Review Office.
units.literal: On xinchou Goryeo sent its Broad Review vice director Jin Renfeng.

units.zh: 十二月癸丑，給事中邊光範、登州刺史郭彥威使於契丹。
units.en: On guichou Bian Guangfan, supervising secretary, and Guo Yanwei of Deng went on embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: On guichou Supervising Secretary Bian Guangfan and Deng prefecture commissioner Guo Yanwei were sent on embassy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 甲寅，高麗使太相來。
units.en: On jiayin a Goryeo grand minister (taesang) envoy arrived.
units.literal: On jiayin the Goryeo envoy Taixiang came.

units.zh: 平盧軍節度使楊光遠反，淄州刺史翟進宗死之。
units.en: Yang Guangyuan, commissioner of the Pinglu army, rose in revolt; Zhai Jinzong, commissioner of Zi, was killed defending his post.
units.literal: Pinglu army commissioner Yang Guangyuan rebelled; Zi prefecture commissioner Zhai Jinzong died in the fighting.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，契丹寇滄州。
units.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the first Kaiyun year Khitan forces struck Cang prefecture.
units.literal: In spring of the first Kaiyun year, on the jiaxu new moon, the Khitan raided Cang prefecture.

units.zh: 己卯，陷貝州。
units.en: On jimao Bei prefecture fell.
units.literal: On jimao they took Bei prefecture.

units.zh: 庚辰，歸德軍節度使高行周為北面行營都部署。
units.en: On gengchen Gao Xingzhou of the Guide army was named overall commander of the northern front.
units.literal: On gengchen Guide army commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made overall commander of the northern campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 契丹入雁門，寇代州。
units.en: Khitan columns passed Yanmen and raided Dai prefecture.
units.literal: The Khitan entered Yanmen and raided Dai prefecture.

units.zh: 辛巳，殿直王班使於契丹，至於鄴都，不得進而復。
units.en: On xinsi Wang Ban of the Palace Attendants was sent to the Khitan; at Ye he found the road blocked and turned back.
units.literal: On xinsi Palace Attendant cadet Wang Ban was sent on embassy to the Khitan; reaching the capital of Ye he could not advance and returned.

units.zh: 晉自高祖以父事契丹甚謹，而歲時遣使，舊史、實錄皆不書。
units.en: From Gaozu on, Jin served the Khitan as a father with punctilious care, sending regular envoys, though the old history and Veritable Records did not record them all.
units.literal: From Gaozu onward, Jin served the Khitan as a father with great care, and sent envoys seasonally, but the old history and Veritable Records did not write them all.

units.zh: 至出帝立，使者旁午不絕，不可勝數，故其官卑者皆略而不書，班以不得進，故書。
units.en: After the Fleeing Emperor took the throne, envoys came and went incessantly, too many to count, so those of low rank are generally omitted. Wang Ban is recorded because he was unable to proceed.
units.literal: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne, envoys crossed back and forth without cease and could not be counted, so those of low office were all abbreviated and not written; Ban is written because he could not advance.

units.zh: 大饑。
units.en: Famine gripped the realm.
units.literal: Great famine.

units.zh: 壬午，前靜難軍節度使李周留守東京，景延廣為御營使。
units.en: On renwu Li Zhou, former commissioner of Jingnan, stayed to guard the Eastern Capital while Jing Yanguang took command of the imperial camp.
units.literal: On renwu former Jingnan army commissioner Li Zhou remained to guard the Eastern Capital, and Jing Yanguang was made commissioner of the imperial camp.

units.zh: 乙酉，北征。
units.en: On yiyou the emperor marched north.
units.literal: On yiyou the northern expedition set out.

units.zh: 丙戌，契丹寇黎陽。
units.en: On bingxu Khitan forces raided Liyang.
units.literal: On bingxu the Khitan raided Liyang.

units.zh: 辛卯，講武於澶州。
units.en: On xinmao the army drilled at Chanzou.
units.literal: On xinmao military exercises were held at Chanzou.

units.zh: 契丹屯於元城，趙延壽寇南樂。
units.en: The Khitan main force camped at Yuancheng while Zhao Yanshou struck Nanle.
units.literal: The Khitan encamped at Yuancheng; Zhao Yanshou raided Nanle.

units.zh: 甲午，劉知遠為幽州道行營招討使。
units.en: On jiawu Liu Zhiyuan was appointed requisition commissioner for the Youzhou campaign.
units.literal: On jiawu Liu Zhiyuan was made requisition commissioner on the Youzhou route campaign.

units.zh: 括馬。
units.en: The court impressed horses from the people.
units.literal: Horses were requisitioned.

units.zh: 丙申，契丹寇黎陽。
units.en: On bingshen the Khitan raided Liyang again.
units.literal: On bingshen the Khitan again raided Liyang.

units.zh: 辛丑，劉知遠及契丹偉王戰於秀容，敗之。
units.en: On xinchou Liu Zhiyuan met the Khitan Prince Weiwang at Xiurong and routed him.
units.literal: On xinchou Liu Zhiyuan fought the Khitan Prince Weiwang at Xiurong and defeated him.

units.zh: 博州刺史周儒叛降於契丹。
units.en: Zhou Ru, commissioner of Bo, defected to the Khitan.
units.literal: Bo prefecture commissioner Zhou Ru rebelled and surrendered to the Khitan.

units.zh: 二月戊申，前軍都虞候李守貞及契丹戰於馬家渡，敗之。
units.en: On wushen Li Shouzhen, chief of the vanguard, fought the Khitan at Majia Ford and drove them off.
units.literal: On wushen vanguard chief Li Shouzhen fought the Khitan at Majia Ford and defeated them.

units.zh: 癸丑，北面行營都虞候馬全節及契丹戰於北平，敗之。
units.en: On guichou Ma Quanjie, chief of the northern headquarters, met the Khitan at Beiping and defeated them.
units.literal: On guichou northern headquarters chief Ma Quanjie fought the Khitan at Beiping and defeated them.

units.zh: 三月癸酉，及契丹戰於戚城，契丹去。
units.en: On guiyou the Jin army fought the Khitan at Weicheng and the invaders withdrew.
units.literal: On guiyou they fought the Khitan at Weicheng; the Khitan withdrew.

units.zh: 戰而兩各傷失，收兵徐去，晉不能追，故以自去為文。
units.en: The battle hurt both sides. The Khitan gathered their troops and withdrew slowly, and Jin could not pursue; therefore the text phrases it as their own departure.
units.literal: They fought and both sides suffered losses; they gathered their troops and slowly withdrew, and Jin could not pursue, so the wording says that they went of themselves.

units.zh: 己丑，冀州刺史白從暉及契丹戰於衡水，敗之。
units.en: On jichou Bai Conghui of Ji fought the Khitan at Hengshui and beat them back.
units.literal: On jichou Ji prefecture commissioner Bai Conghui fought the Khitan at Hengshui and defeated them.

units.zh: 癸巳，籍民為武定軍。
units.en: On guisi commoners were conscripted into the Wuding army.
units.literal: On guisi the people were registered for the Wuding army.

units.zh: 夏四月，契丹陷德州，沿河巡檢使梁進敗之，取德州。
units.en: In the fourth month the Khitan seized De prefecture; Liang Jin, river-route inspector, counterattacked, defeated them, and retook the city.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer the Khitan took De prefecture; river-route inspector Liang Jin defeated them and recovered De prefecture.

units.zh: 甲寅，至自澶州，赦京師。
units.en: On jiayin he returned from Chanzou and proclaimed an amnesty for the capital.
units.literal: On jiayin the emperor returned from Chanzou and pardoned the capital.

units.zh: 己未，馬全範及契丹戰於定豐，敗之。
units.en: On jiwei Ma Quanjie met the Khitan at Dingfeng and drove them off.
units.literal: On jiwei Ma Quanjie fought the Khitan at Dingfeng and defeated them.

units.zh: 辛酉，率借民財。
units.en: On xinyou the court imposed compulsory loans on private wealth.
units.literal: On xinyou the people’s wealth was levied on compulsory loan.

units.zh: 五月戊寅，李守貞討楊光遠。
units.en: On wuyin of the fifth month Li Shouzhen marched against Yang Guangyuan.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin, Li Shouzhen campaigned against Yang Guangyuan.

units.zh: 丁亥，鄴都留守張從恩為貝州行營都部署。
units.en: On dinghai Zhang Congen, regent of the Ye capital, was named overall commander of the Bei prefecture field headquarters.
units.literal: On dinghai Ye capital regent Zhang Congen was made overall commander of the Bei prefecture campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 辛卯，李守貞為青州行營都部署。
units.en: On xinmao Li Shouzhen was appointed overall commander of the Qingzhou field headquarters.
units.literal: On xinmao Li Shouzhen was made overall commander of the Qingzhou campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 六月，克淄州。
units.en: In the sixth month Zi prefecture fell.
units.literal: In the sixth month Zi prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 丙午，復置樞密使。
units.en: On bingwu the court restored the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: On bingwu the Bureau of Military Affairs was reinstated.

units.zh: 丁未，侍中桑維翰為中書令，充樞密使。
units.en: On dingwei Palace Secretary Sang Weihan became Director of the Secretariat and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: On dingwei Palace Secretary Sang Weihan was made Director of the Secretariat and also served as Bureau commissioner.

units.zh: 丙辰，河決滑州，環梁山，入於汶、濟。
units.en: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Hua prefecture, swung round Liangshan, and flooded into the Wen and Ji.
units.literal: On bingchen the Yellow River burst its banks at Hua prefecture, encircled Liangshan, and poured into the Wen and Ji.

units.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，大赦，改元。
units.en: On the xinwei new moon of the seventh month the throne proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign era.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei new moon, a great amnesty; the reign title was changed.

units.zh: 己丑，太子太傅劉句守司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
units.en: On jichou Liu Ju, grand preceptor to the heir, was made acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as vice director of the Chancellery and associate grand councilor.
units.literal: On jichou Grand Preceptor to the Heir Liu Ju was made acting Minister of Works and concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 八月辛丑朔，劉知遠為北面行營都統，順德軍節度使杜威為都招討使。
units.en: On the xinchou new moon of the eighth month Liu Zhiyuan took command of the northern field army as overall commander, and Du Wei of Shunde was named overall repression commissioner.
units.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the eighth month Liu Zhiyuan was made overall commander of the northern campaign headquarters, and Shunde army commissioner Du Wei was made overall repression commissioner.

units.zh: 戊辰，旌表陳州項城民史仁詡門閭。
units.en: On wuchen the court honored the household gate of Shi Renxu, a man of Xiangcheng in Chen prefecture, for exemplary conduct.
units.literal: On wuchen the gate and lane of Shi Renxu, a commoner of Xiangcheng in Chen prefecture, were marked with honor.

units.zh: 九月丙子，契丹寇遂城、樂壽，代州刺史白文珂及契丹戰於七里烽，敗之。
units.en: On bingzi of the ninth month Khitan forces struck Suicheng and Leshou; Bai Wenke of Dai met them at Qili Beacon and beat them back.
units.literal: On bingzi in the ninth month the Khitan raided Suicheng and Leshou; Dai prefecture commissioner Bai Wenke fought the Khitan at Qili Beacon and defeated them.

units.zh: 冬十月庚戌，武寧軍節度使趙在禮為北面行營副都統，鄴都留守馬全節為副招討使。
units.en: On gengxu of the tenth month Zhao Zaili of Wuning became deputy overall commander of the northern front, and Ma Quanjie, regent of the Ye capital, deputy repression commissioner.
units.literal: On gengxu in the tenth month of winter Wuning army commissioner Zhao Zaili was made deputy overall commander of the northern campaign headquarters, and Ye capital regent Ma Quanjie was made deputy repression commissioner.

units.zh: 十二月己亥朔，射兔於臯門。
units.en: On the jihai new moon of the twelfth month the emperor hunted rabbits at Gaomen.
units.literal: On the jihai new moon of the twelfth month rabbits were shot at Gaomen.

units.zh: 丁巳，楊承勳囚其父光遠以降，殺之。
units.en: On dingsi, Yang Chengxun seized his father Guangyuan, surrendered, and killed him.
units.literal: On dingsi, Yang Chengxun imprisoned his father Guangyuan in order to surrender, and killed him.

units.zh: 出帝已許其不死，既而命李守貞自殺之，故不書伏誅。
units.en: The Fleeing Emperor had promised to spare him, but later ordered Li Shouzhen to have him killed; for that reason the text does not say he was executed.
units.literal: The Deposed Emperor had already promised that he would not die, but afterward ordered Li Shouzhen to have him killed; therefore the text does not write that he was executed.

units.zh: 閏月乙酉，德音赦青州囚。
units.en: On yiyou of the intercalary month a grace edict freed Qingzhou’s prisoners.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on yiyou, a grace edict pardoned Qingzhou’s prisoners.

units.zh: 契丹寇恒州。
units.en: Khitan forces raided Heng prefecture.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Heng prefecture.

units.zh: 二年春正月，契丹陷泰州。
units.en: In the first month of the second year Khitan troops seized Taizhou.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, in the first month, the Khitan took Taizhou.

units.zh: 壬子，馬全節及契丹戰於榆林，兩軍皆潰。
units.en: On renzi Ma Quanjie clashed with the Khitan at Yulin and both sides broke in rout.
units.literal: On renzi Ma Quanjie fought the Khitan at Yulin; both armies broke and fled.

units.zh: 戊午，幸南莊，張從恩留守東都。
units.en: On wuwu he went to Nanzhuang while Zhang Congen stayed behind to guard the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On wuwu he visited Nanzhuang; Zhang Congen remained to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 辛酉，高行周為御營使。
units.en: On xinyou Gao Xingzhou was appointed commissioner of the imperial camp.
units.literal: On xinyou Gao Xingzhou was made commissioner of the imperial camp.

units.zh: 乙丑，北征，契丹去。
units.en: On yichou the emperor marched north and the Khitan withdrew.
units.literal: On yichou the northern expedition set out; the Khitan withdrew.

units.zh: 二月己巳，幸黎陽。
units.en: On jisi of the second month he traveled to Liyang.
units.literal: On jisi of the second month he visited Liyang.

units.zh: 橫海軍節度使田武為東北面行營都部署，以備契丹。
units.en: Tian Wu of Henghai was named overall commander of the northeast field army to hold the line against the Khitan.
units.literal: Henghai army commissioner Tian Wu was made overall commander of the northeast campaign headquarters to guard against the Khitan.

units.zh: 曰「以備契丹」，嫌契丹去而命將。
units.en: The phrase “to prepare against the Khitan” is used lest readers think a commander was appointed only after the Khitan had left.
units.literal: It says “to prepare against the Khitan” because one might suspect that a commander was appointed after the Khitan had gone.

units.zh: 丙子，大閱於戚城。
units.en: On bingzi the army held a grand review at Qicheng.
units.literal: On bingzi a grand review was held at Qicheng.

units.zh: 丙戌，閱馬於鐵丘。
units.en: On bingxu the emperor inspected horses at Tieqiu.
units.literal: On bingxu horses were reviewed at Tieqiu.

units.zh: 丙申，端明殿學士、尚書戶部侍郎馮玉為戶部尚書、樞密使。
units.en: On bingshen Feng Yu, Hanlin academician and vice minister of revenue, was promoted to revenue minister and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: On bingshen Hanlin academician and Revenue vice minister Feng Yu was made Revenue minister and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 三月戊戌，契丹陷祁州，刺史沈斌死之。
units.en: On wuxu of the third month Qizhou fell to the Khitan and its commissioner Shen Bin was killed.
units.literal: On wuxu of the third month the Khitan took Qizhou; commissioner Shen Bin died in the fighting.

units.zh: 丁未，畋於戚城。
units.en: On dingwei he hunted at Qicheng.
units.literal: On dingwei he hunted at Qicheng.

units.zh: 庚戌，馬全節克泰州。
units.en: On gengxu Ma Quanjie recovered Taizhou.
units.literal: On gengxu Ma Quanjie took Taizhou.

units.zh: 辛亥，易州戍將孫方諫及契丹諧裏戰於狼山，敗之。
units.en: On xinhai Sun Fangjian, garrison commander of Yizhou, met the Khitan Xieli at Langshan and routed him.
units.literal: On xinhai Yizhou garrison commander Sun Fangjian fought the Khitan Xieli at Langshan and defeated him.

units.zh: 甲寅，杜威克滿城。
units.en: On jiayin Du Wei captured Mancheng.
units.literal: On jiayin Du Wei took Mancheng.

units.zh: 乙卯，克遂城。
units.en: On yimao Suicheng was recovered.
units.literal: On yimao Suicheng was taken.

units.zh: 庚申，杜威及契丹戰於陽城，敗之，追奔至於衛村，又敗之。
units.en: On gengshen Du Wei routed the Khitan at Yangcheng, chased them to Weicun, and defeated them again.
units.literal: On gengshen Du Wei fought the Khitan at Yangcheng and defeated them; pursuing the fugitives to Weicun, he defeated them again.

units.zh: 夏四月戊寅，勞旋於戚城。
units.en: On wuyin of the fourth month the court feasted the victorious army at Qicheng.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, the returning army was rewarded at Qicheng.

units.zh: 己卯，勞旋於王莽河。
units.en: On jimao the victorious army was feasted at Wangmang River.
units.literal: On jimao the returning army was rewarded at Wangmang River.

units.zh: 甲申，至自澶州，赦左右軍囚。
units.en: On jiashen he returned from Chanzou and freed the prisoners of the Left and Right Armies.
units.literal: On jiashen he returned from Chanzou and pardoned the Left and Right Army prisoners.

units.zh: 庚寅，大賞軍功。
units.en: On gengyin the throne lavished rewards on the army for its merit.
units.literal: On gengyin military merit was richly rewarded.

units.zh: 五月丙申朔，大赦。
units.en: On the bingshen new moon of the fifth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On the bingshen new moon of the fifth month, a great amnesty.

units.zh: 丙午，幸南莊。
units.en: On bingwu he went to Nanzhuang.
units.literal: On bingwu he visited Nanzhuang.

units.zh: 六月丁卯，射於繁臺，幸杜威第。
units.en: On dingmao of the sixth month he practiced archery at Fantai and called at Du Wei’s mansion.
units.literal: On dingmao of the sixth month he shot at Fantai and visited Du Wei’s residence.

units.zh: 旱。
units.en: Drought struck the land.
units.literal: Drought.

units.zh: 秋八月甲子朔，廢二舞。
units.en: On the jiazi new moon of the eighth month the court abolished the Wen and Wu ritual dances.
units.literal: On the jiazi new moon of the eighth month of autumn the two ritual dances were abolished.

units.zh: 丙寅，和凝罷。
units.en: On bingyin He Ning was dismissed.
units.literal: On bingyin He Ning left office.

units.zh: 馮玉為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Feng Yu was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and associate grand councilor.
units.literal: Feng Yu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 辛未，閱馬於茂澤陂。
units.en: On xinwei the emperor inspected horses at Maoze Marsh.
units.literal: On xinwei horses were reviewed at Maoze Marsh.

units.zh: 丁丑，括馬。
units.en: On dingchou the court again impressed horses from the people.
units.literal: On dingchou horses were impressed.

units.zh: 九月己亥，閱馬於萬龍岡，幸李守貞第。
units.en: On jihai he inspected horses at Wanlong Ridge and called at Li Shouzhen’s mansion.
units.literal: On jihai horses were reviewed at Wanlong Ridge and he visited Li Shouzhen’s residence.

units.zh: 冬十月丁丑，高麗使其廣評侍郎韓玄珪、禮賓卿金廉等來。
units.en: On dingchou of the tenth month Goryeo sent Han Xuangui, vice director of the Broad Review Office, Ritual Host Jin Lian, and others.
units.literal: On dingchou in the tenth month of winter Goryeo sent its Broad Review vice director Han Xuangui, Ritual Host Jin Lian, and others.

units.zh: 戊寅，射兔於硯臺。
units.en: On wuyin he hunted rabbits at Yantai.
units.literal: On wuyin rabbits were shot at Yantai.

units.zh: 戊子，高麗使其兵部侍郎劉崇珪、內軍卿樸藝言來。
units.en: On wuzi Goryeo sent Liu Chonggui of the War Ministry and Bak Eonyeol, director of the Inner Army.
units.literal: On wuzi Goryeo sent its War Ministry vice director Liu Chonggui and Inner Army director Bak Eonyeol.

units.zh: 十一月戊戌，封王武為高麗國王。
units.en: On wuxu of the eleventh month Wang Wu was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.
units.literal: On wuxu of the eleventh month Wang Wu was enfeoffed King of Goryeo.

units.zh: 己巳，射兔於臯門，幸沙臺。
units.en: On jisi he hunted rabbits at Gaomen and went on to Shatai.
units.literal: On jisi rabbits were shot at Gaomen and he visited Shatai.

units.zh: 十二月丁丑，臘，畋於郊。
units.en: On dingchou of the twelfth month, at the La festival, he hunted outside the walls.
units.literal: On dingchou of the twelfth month, at the La festival, he hunted in the suburbs.

units.zh: 丁亥，桑維翰罷。
units.en: On dinghai Sang Weihan was dismissed.
units.literal: On dinghai Sang Weihan left office.

units.zh: 開封尹趙瑩為中書令，李崧守侍中、樞密使。
units.en: Zhao Ying, metropolitan magistrate of Kaifeng, became director of the Secretariat; Li Song kept his posts as palace secretary and Bureau commissioner.
units.literal: Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate Zhao Ying was made Director of the Secretariat; Li Song remained Palace Secretary and Bureau commissioner.

units.zh: 三年春二月丙子，回鶻使突厥陸來。
units.en: On bingzi of the second month in the third year the Uyghur envoy Turku Lu arrived.
units.literal: In spring of the third year, on bingzi of the second month, the Uyghur envoy Turku Lu came.

units.zh: 壬午，射鴨於板橋，幸南莊。
units.en: On renwu he shot ducks at Banqiao and went on to Nanzhuang.
units.literal: On renwu ducks were shot at Banqiao and he visited Nanzhuang.

units.zh: 夏六月，孫方諫以狼山叛附於契丹。
units.en: In the sixth month Sun Fangjian rebelled at Langshan and went over to the Khitan.
units.literal: In the sixth month of summer Sun Fangjian rebelled at Langshan and submitted to the Khitan.

units.zh: 丙寅，契丹寇邊。
units.en: On bingyin Khitan forces raided the border.
units.literal: On bingyin the Khitan raided the frontier.

units.zh: 己丑，李守貞為行營都部署，義成軍節度使皇甫遇為副。
units.en: On jichou Li Shouzhen was named overall commander of the field army, with Huangfu Yu of Yicheng as his deputy.
units.literal: On jichou Li Shouzhen was made overall commander of the campaign headquarters, and Yicheng army commissioner Huangfu Yu was made his deputy.

units.zh: 河決漁池。
units.en: The Yellow River broke through at Yuchi.
units.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Yuchi.

units.zh: 大饑，群盜起。
units.en: Famine gripped the realm and bands of robbers sprang up.
units.literal: Great famine; bandits rose everywhere.

units.zh: 秋七月，大雨，水，河決楊劉、朝城、武德。
units.en: In the seventh month torrential rains swelled the rivers; the Yellow River broke through at Yangliu, Chaocheng, and Wude.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn great rains fell and the waters rose; the river burst at Yangliu, Chaocheng, and Wude.

units.zh: 八月辛酉，河溢歷亭。
units.en: On xinyou of the eighth month the Yellow River flooded Liting.
units.literal: On xinyou of the eighth month the river overflowed at Liting.

units.zh: 九月，河決澶、滑、懷州。
units.en: In the ninth month the Yellow River broke through in Chan, Hua, and Huai prefectures.
units.literal: In the ninth month the river burst at Chan, Hua, and Huai prefectures.

units.zh: 辛丑，行營馬軍排陣使張彥澤及契丹戰於新興，敗之。
units.en: On xinchou Zhang Yanze, chief of the campaign horse array, met the Khitan at Xinxing and drove them off.
units.literal: On xinchou campaign cavalry array chief Zhang Yanze fought the Khitan at Xinxing and defeated them.

units.zh: 癸卯，劉知遠及契丹戰於朔州，敗之。
units.en: On guimao Liu Zhiyuan routed the Khitan at Shuozhou.
units.literal: On guimao Liu Zhiyuan fought the Khitan at Shuozhou and defeated them.

units.zh: 大雨霖，河決臨黃。
units.en: Weeks of heavy rain broke the river at Linhuang.
units.literal: Great prolonged rains; the river burst at Linhuang.

units.zh: 冬十月，河決衛州，丙寅，河決原武。
units.en: In the tenth month the Yellow River broke through at Wei prefecture; on bingyin it burst again at Yuanwu.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter the river burst at Wei prefecture; on bingyin it burst at Yuanwu.

units.zh: 辛未，杜威為北面行營都招討使，李守貞為兵馬都監。
units.en: On xinwei Du Wei was named overall repression commissioner of the northern front, and Li Shouzhen overseer of army and horse.
units.literal: On xinwei Du Wei was made overall repression commissioner of the northern campaign headquarters, and Li Shouzhen was made overseer of army and horse.

units.zh: 十一月，永靜軍節度使梁漢璋及契丹戰於瀛州，敗績。
units.en: In the eleventh month Liang Hanzhang of Yongjing met the Khitan at Ying prefecture and suffered a crushing defeat.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Yongjing army commissioner Liang Hanzhang fought the Khitan at Ying prefecture and was defeated.

units.zh: 契丹寇鎮、定。
units.en: Khitan columns raided Zhen and Ding prefectures.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Zhen and Ding.

units.zh: 十二月己未，杜威軍於中渡。
units.en: On jiwei of the twelfth month Du Wei’s army camped at Zhongdu Ford.
units.literal: On jiwei of the twelfth month Du Wei encamped at Zhongdu Ford.

units.zh: 壬戌，奉國都指揮使王清及契丹戰於滹沱，敗績，死之。
units.en: On renxu Wang Qing of the Fengguo army met the Khitan on the Hutuo, was routed, and fell in battle.
units.literal: On renxu Fengguo army commander Wang Qing fought the Khitan on the Hutuo and was defeated; he died in the fighting.

units.zh: 杜威、李守貞、張彥澤以其軍叛降於契丹。
units.en: Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and Zhang Yanze turned their armies and defected to the Khitan.
units.literal: Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and Zhang Yanze led their armies in rebellion and surrendered to the Khitan.

units.zh: 庚午，射兔於沙臺。
units.en: On gengwu he hunted rabbits at Shatai.
units.literal: On gengwu rabbits were shot at Shatai.

units.zh: 壬申，張彥澤犯京師，殺開封尹桑維翰。
units.en: On renshen Zhang Yanze stormed the capital and killed Sang Weihan, metropolitan magistrate of Kaifeng.
units.literal: On renshen Zhang Yanze violated the capital and killed Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate Sang Weihan.

units.zh: 契丹滅晉。
units.en: The Khitan destroyed Jin.
units.literal: The Khitan destroyed Jin.

units.zh: 出帝雖存，而晉則亡已，故書「滅」。
units.en: Although the Fleeing Emperor was still alive, Jin had already fallen, so the text writes “destroyed.”
units.literal: Although the Deposed Emperor still survived, Jin had already perished, and therefore it writes “destroyed.”

units.zh: 嗚呼，余書「封子重貴為鄭王」，又書「追封皇伯敬儒為宋王」者，豈無意哉！
units.en: Alas! When I recorded that “Chonggui was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng as a son,” and again that “the imperial uncle Jingru was posthumously made Prince of Song,” was I writing without purpose?
units.literal: Alas! That I wrote “Chonggui was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng as a son,” and also wrote “Jingru the imperial uncle was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Song”—was that without intent!

units.zh: 《禮》：「兄弟之子，猶子也。」
units.en: The Book of Rites says: “A brother’s son counts as a son.”
units.literal: The Rites says: “A brother’s son is like a son.”

units.zh: 重貴書子可也，敬儒出帝父也，書曰皇伯者何哉？
units.en: Chonggui might properly be called “son.” Jingru was the Fleeing Emperor’s own father—so why does the text say “imperial uncle”?
units.literal: It would do to style Chonggui “son”; Jingru was the Fleeing Emperor’s father—so why write “imperial uncle”?

units.zh: 出帝立不以正，而絕其所生也。
units.en: The Fleeing Emperor took the throne by an illegitimate path and cut himself off from his natural father.
units.literal: The Fleeing Emperor’s accession was not legitimate, and he severed ties with the one who begot him.

units.zh: 蓋出帝於高祖，得為子而不得為後者，高祖自有子也。
units.en: Between the Fleeing Emperor and Gaozu he might count as a son, but he could not be made heir, for Gaozu already had sons of his own.
units.literal: As to the Fleeing Emperor and Gaozu, he could be treated as a son but could not be made heir—for Gaozu already had sons of his own.

units.zh: 方高祖疾病，抱其子重睿置於馮道懷中而托之，出帝豈得立邪？
units.en: On Gaozu’s sickbed he laid his son Chongrui in Feng Dao’s arms and entrusted the boy to him—how then could the Fleeing Emperor have been raised to the throne?
units.literal: When Gaozu lay ill he placed his son Chongrui in Feng Dao’s arms and entrusted him—how could the Fleeing Emperor have been enthroned?

units.zh: 晉之大臣，既違禮廢命而立之，以謂出帝為高祖子則得立，為敬儒子則不得立，於是深諱其所生而絕之，以欺天下為真高祖子也。
units.en: Jin’s chief ministers, having defied ritual and the dying command in placing him on the throne, reasoned that if the Fleeing Emperor were counted as Gaozu’s son he could reign, but not if he were Jingru’s son; so they buried his true parentage and cut it off, palming him off to the world as Gaozu’s own.
units.literal: Jin’s great ministers, having violated ritual and set aside the late emperor’s command in enthroning him, held that if the Fleeing Emperor were Gaozu’s son he might reign, but if he were Jingru’s son he might not; thereupon they deeply concealed his birth and severed it, deceiving the realm into believing him Gaozu’s true son.

units.zh: 《禮》曰：「為人後者，為其父母服。」
units.en: The Rites also says: “One who becomes another’s heir still wears mourning for his natural parents.”
units.literal: The Rites says: “One who becomes another’s heir still mourns his natural parents.”

units.zh: 使高祖無子，出帝得為後而立以正，則不待絕其所生以為欺也。
units.en: Had Gaozu had no sons, and the Fleeing Emperor been made a lawful heir and enthroned in proper form, there would have been no call to sever his natural ties as a lie.
units.literal: Had Gaozu been without sons and the Fleeing Emperor been made a legitimate heir and enthroned by right, there would have been no need to sever his birth ties as a fraud.

units.zh: 故余書曰「追封皇伯敬儒為宋王」者，以見其立不以正，而滅絕天性，臣其父而爵之，以欺天下也。
units.en: That is why I wrote “the imperial uncle Jingru was posthumously made Prince of Song”: to show that his accession was illegitimate, that he killed natural feeling, made his own father a subject while granting him a princely title, and lied to the world.
units.literal: Therefore when I wrote “Jingru the imperial uncle was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Song,” it was to show that his enthronement was not legitimate, that he extinguished natural affection, ennobled the man who was his father while styling himself that father’s subject, and deceived the realm.
